rationale: Exact proposal, candidate, authored-v8 and both semantic-review bindings were independently verified, with all 132 current runtime hashes and nine source bindings matching. All 322 proposal node snapshots match the authoritative current KG; the 29 differences from the pre-export bundle are only seven alias lists and 22 degree fields. The 85 unchanged authored boards preserve their inherited factual source URL history and have zero exclusions. The recorded native/direct-handler audit covers exactly 45 Intrusul and 40 Perechi replay IDs with matching proposal identities, bounded public seeds, 460 requests, score 1000, hidden-answer protection and terminal-GET preservation. The 333 served frozen core boards are structurally preserved, with the three exact release-reserve records excluded from the 336-row derived payload; those core boards were not replayed. This accepts the saved native audit scope and does not claim full external-server HTTP coverage or approval of graph-held items.
